answer: Work waits on the dawn until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the spiral of the next round. By the grove of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, capped per identity per epoch. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
